summary: Treat physical topology, power state, calibration, and exclusive ownership as prerequisites to hardware writes.
instructions: Separate read-only discovery from power, flash, reset, relay, or instrument-output actions.
Before a write, require a topology record, voltage/current limits, device identity, lease, recovery path, and human confirmation of physical state.
Never infer switch positions, shared grounds, external supplies, or instrument output state from software alone.
Record calibration, firmware, wiring, and environmental conditions with the run.
